overview: An accessible AI assistant that asks which assistance pathway you need and routes you into a working module for visual, communication, cognitive or mobility support.
features: Choose an assistance pathway from the AI core page
Visual module with image description, read-aloud and voice input
Communication module with chatbot, speech-to-text, text-to-speech and sign-language phrases
Cognitive module with text simplification, summaries and step-by-step instructions
Mobility module with voice-controlled navigation and hands-free controls
Shared AI assistant on every module page
High-contrast mode and adjustable text size
